title: feat(classical-performances): implement Enterprise Indian Classical Performances Explorer Suite
body:
### Summary
This issue tracks the implementation of the **Enterprise Indian Classical Performances Explorer Suite** — an interactive dashboard for exploring Indian classical ragas, dance forms, and legendary performers.

### Features Implemented
- 🎵 **Raga Explorer** — 12 classical ragas with mood, time-of-day, origin, and instrument metadata
- 💃 **Dance Form Explorer** — 14 classical/folk/tribal dance traditions with detailed feature breakdowns
- 🎼 **Performers Database** — 12 legendary Indian classical performers across vocal, instrumental, and dance disciplines
- 📊 **Analytics Dashboard** — State-wise distribution, raga mood breakdown, dance tradition charts, and historical timeline
- 🔍 **Global Search & Filter** — Multi-term fuzzy search with category filters, sub-filters, and sorting

### Technical Details
- **HTML** (301 lines): Glassmorphic dark-mode dashboard with ARIA landmarks and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
- **CSS** (911 lines): Responsive glassmorphic styling with CSS custom properties, animated hero, and mobile breakpoints
- **JavaScript** (843 lines): Class-based `PerformanceEngine` with filtering, sorting, search, and analytics
- **Tests** (586 lines): 67 Vitest unit tests covering all engine methods, models, filters, analytics, and render functions

### Total Line Count: 2,641 lines
